rationale: Open the faulted branch l23 to isolate the b2-b3 section, then close the normally-open tie switch tie_24 (b2-b4). The resulting closed set {l_s1, l12, tie_24, l34} forms a radial tree connecting source s to b1, b2, b3, and b4, restoring all load buses: priority sum 3+5+2=10 (meets min_priority_restored=10) and 170 kW of load with 2 switching actions.
